layers.name: Power Distribution (Room to Row to Rack)

EPC.rationale: Novel grid-forming / 800VDC power conversion topology — high-complexity ETO, per EPC Power's own product profile.

CROWN.rationale: Bespoke arc-resistant switchgear and E-Houses engineered per utility/site spec.

EP2.rationale: Explicitly labeled 'Engineered-to-order' on Flex's own site; bespoke substation control and protection panels.

ANORD.rationale: Standardized, modular switchgear and building blocks configured from parametric rules.

FPM.rationale: Catalog board-level DC-DC converters and power shelves, standardized part numbers.

JETCOOL.rationale: Productized cold plates and CDUs (SmartPlate, SmartSense) with configurable, catalog-driven options.

CLOUD.rationale: Rack-scale integration of already-selected components — assembly, not bespoke design.

component_overrides.reason: Standard enclosures are catalog items even within an otherwise bespoke EP2/Crown panel.
Standard busbar fittings are catalog components regardless of the surrounding panel's engineering complexity.
Standard breaker families are catalog-selectable even inside a bespoke protection panel.
Explicit signal of a first-of-kind design reinforces exception routing even if a brand default were otherwise automated.
Explicit novelty signal overrides any brand default toward mandatory specialist routing.
